_source: Synthesized 2026-10-18 for F41 (fmc_vpn_status) from the FMC 10.0.1 spec (FTDS2SVpnModel, VpnEndpoint, TunnelStatus with IVpnPeer vpnInterface/vtiInterface, TunnelDetail example verbatim) and the FTD 10.0 CLI formats of show crypto ikev2 sa / ipsec sa / vpn-sessiondb l2l / route (show crypto ikev2 stats is the recorded one from ftd_sdwan_show.json). The lab had no VPN topology during Stage 1 (0 in Global/mcp-test-leaf); re-record from mcp-fw-t1 in Stage 2. Documentation addresses only.
